facts.fact: Bindu reads the final glyph as the crew knot-song thaw sign; the queen holds that Harish was found on the slope at the thaw and carried down (ch29/31 consistent).
Ila argues Harish walked out of the Under-Cairn alive as evidence for the hill sense of 'carried'; the queen holds the mountain took his life anyway; neither can be proved.
Pritam escaped six nights before the rider's arrival; scouts found tracks a day old; the rider spent four days on the road on a lamed pony.
Captain Raghu's brass shoulder bells were found in the snow beside Pritam's east tracks.
Ila kept the east line off the Shared Map she signed; the dotted line on her private copy is anchored to the shoulder above the Meadow Cairn along the Shepherd's Stair points.

Lata loaded her convoy weeks before the thaw; a council drover met her on the lane below Kothi Shilak and told her the grey-bearded officer story, having asked Nimmi at Ranu on his way up. Retire provisional F624 and F630.
